advice_items.quote: Never get money advice from somebody that makes less money than you, never get business advice from somebody who's got a smaller business than you.
advice_items.summary_en: Only take financial and business advice from people who have achieved greater results than you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 只向比自己更富有、生意更大的人请教

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: Every industry is competitive and I actually salivate at the mouth when I find out an industry is competitive because it means there's a lot of people in it.
advice_items.summary_en: Seek out competitive markets because high competition proves strong customer demand and opportunity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 拥抱竞争激烈的赛道，人多代表市场大

advice_items.quote: If you're willing to grind like a gorilla in the markets that are competitive you're always going to win.
advice_items.summary_en: Outwork complacent competitors relentlessly to dominate any competitive industry.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在竞争市场里拼命苦干就能击败懈怠者

guests.first_money_or_break: 创业约28年，9年前银行账户一度只剩78美元，通过专注学习销售与授权管理，在全美医疗睡眠检测行业击败大型老牌竞争对手并做到行业第一。
guests.guest_name: Tampa Medical Sleep Testing Company Owner
guests.role_or_title: Owner of Largest Medical Sleep Testing Company in the US
guests.zero_start_advice: 只向结果比你更好的人请教钱和生意；不要害怕竞争激烈的市场，在多数人松懈时保持狠劲就能赢。

advice_items.quote: Assume the close... if you're trying to close somebody make that person laugh cuz nobody's going to say no to someone that they like.
advice_items.summary_en: Assume the sale from the start and build likability through humor so prospects want to say yes.
advice_items.summary_zh: 预设成交并逗笑客户，让人喜欢你就难拒绝

advice_items.quote: I was sued by a couple billion dollar corporations... I had great business insurance to cover a lot of it, so make sure you got business insurance.
advice_items.summary_en: Carry strong business insurance to protect your company against major lawsuits.
advice_items.summary_zh: 务必买好商业保险以抵御巨额诉讼风险

advice_items.quote: This is not for the weak-hearted... your job is to constantly fix problems so if you can't handle that stress and all those trials and tribulations then don't do it.
advice_items.summary_en: Entrepreneurship requires constant problem-solving under pressure; do not start if you cannot handle the stress.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业就是不断解决问题，抗压差就别入局

advice_items.quote: Figure it the out... work like a son of a, this shit's not going to be given.
advice_items.summary_en: Nothing is handed to you; figure things out independently and outwork everyone with high ambition and confidence.
advice_items.summary_zh: 没人会白给你机会，靠狠劲与野心自己破局

advice_items.quote: Reinvest the money, it's not rocket science... I just had a very high level of ambition in myself and confidence in myself and work ethic in myself.
advice_items.summary_en: Reinvest your profits back into the business rather than taking everything out early.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把赚到的利润持续再投资到事业中滚大

guests.first_money_or_break: 创业10至11年，经营加密数字资产对冲基金并涉足多家企业，曾遭数家十亿美元级公司起诉但凭借商业保险与坚持胜诉，峰值年收入达450万美元。
guests.guest_name: Tampa Digital Assets Hedge Fund Founder
guests.role_or_title: Founder of a Digital Assets Hedge Fund
guests.zero_start_advice: 别等别人施舍，靠超强野心、自信与拼劲自己摸索并把钱投回生意；同时配置好商业保险，做好承受高压的准备。

advice_items.quote: Believe in yourself cuz I doubted myself a lot before I actually took that big leap into working on my own.
advice_items.summary_en: Overcome self-doubt and believe in your ability before making the leap into entrepreneurship.
advice_items.summary_zh: 克服自我怀疑，相信自己才能迈出单干第一步

advice_items.quote: You got to try something, you got to try, you don't know if you don't try.
advice_items.summary_en: Take action and test your ideas instead of staying paralyzed by uncertainty.
advice_items.summary_zh: 必须去尝试，不迈出行动永远不知道结果

advice_items.quote: It's one of the most important things cuz if you marry the wrong person it take you in the opposite direction of what you're trying to go.
advice_items.summary_en: Marrying the right partner propels your growth, whereas the wrong spouse pulls you away from your goals.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选对伴侣至关重要，错的人会拖垮你的方向

advice_items.quote: Faith has been like my number one go-to, that has been kind of like my backbone that I rely on to get through day to day.
advice_items.summary_en: Lean on faith as a daily backbone to stay grounded and persevere through challenges.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把信仰作为日常支柱，支撑自己渡过难关

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: Don't overextend yourself and make sure the money is working for you not against you.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid overleveraging yourself and deploy capital so your money compounds in your favor.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别过度透支负债，要让钱为你工作而非反噬

guests.first_money_or_break: 2019年起自主创业，此前曾多次落魄破产，在丈夫的支持下克服自我怀疑并大胆尝试，如今单年最高收入达250万美元。
guests.zero_start_advice: 相信自己并勇于尝试，选一个能支持你前进的伴侣，保持信仰并避免过度负债。

advice_items.canonical_tag: Work Under a Winner First Before Starting
advice_items.quote: Before I made any real money I was making the copies and making the coffee for people and I just ended up being a really good copy maker and coffee maker.
advice_items.summary_en: Excel at humble entry-level tasks while learning the business before launching your own practice.
advice_items.summary_zh: 入行先从端茶复印等小事做起做到极致

advice_items.quote: I pulled up to a Labor Ready at 3:30 a.m. and worked on the docks to fill up oil barrels with a college degree. I'm not afraid to work, I can live a Spartan life.
advice_items.summary_en: Drop ego, do whatever hard labor is required, and live frugally until you build momentum.
advice_items.summary_zh: 放下身段不怕苦力，必要时过斯巴达式简朴生活

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Move in Silence & Stay Calm Under Pressure
advice_items.quote: Never let them see you sweat, remain calm, remain in control... I moved in silence because if I told them I'm going to change my life they would have started hating.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay composed under pressure and keep your plans private to avoid envy and distractions from others.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持冷静掌控局面，成名前保持低调避免嫉妒

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Stay Humble & Don't Believe Your Own Hype
advice_items.quote: Don't believe your own propaganda. If you start to believe your own hype that you're manufacturing you're going to start making careless decisions and you'll become a tyrant.
advice_items.summary_en: Never buy into your own manufactured hype, as ego leads to reckless decisions and bad leadership.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别轻信自己制造的吹捧，膨胀会让人做出蠢决定

advice_items.quote: Be able to walk away. Everybody's looking for a deal, not me. You get what you pay for, so the first person to speak loses. I present my value... be willing to walk away.
advice_items.summary_en: Demonstrate clear value and case studies, never compete on cheap pricing, and be willing to walk away from bad deals.
advice_items.summary_zh: 展示自身价值与案例，谈判中敢于直接转身离开

advice_items.quote: Faith is super important... in order to follow me you have to have the fear of God and model ourselves after Jesus Christ.
advice_items.summary_en: Ground your character and life decisions in deep religious faith and reverence.
advice_items.summary_zh: 以深厚的宗教信仰与敬畏心塑造自身品格

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身布鲁克林，早年靠卖仿版球鞋和球衣攒钱离开纽约；有大学学历仍凌晨3点半去码头做苦力，入行从复印和端咖啡做起，深耕15年在35岁赚到第一个100万美元，峰值年入140万美元。
guests.wealth_detail: $1.4M peak single-year income; first million at age 35
guests.zero_start_advice: 不怕做底层脏活累活并能过极简生活；在暗处蓄力不要对外炫耀野心，保持冷静与谦逊，谈判中坚守自身价值并敢于拒绝低价单。
